_about: Tool versions this skill release was tested with. install_prerequisites.py installs exactly these, --update moves an installed tool to them, and tool_updates.py reports newer releases without installing them. After testing a newer release end to end (both skills on the testbed), raise the version here in the same pull request as any fix it needed.

graphify.why: graph build; a release changed how graph.json is merged and saved (0.9.53 -> 0.9.77)
